messages.text: What time slots and guest count does your template assume for the checklist?

This room does not have a template that assumes specific time slots or guest counts. You need to provide your own guest reception checklist with task descriptions, required supplies, scheduled times, and explicit constraints for each entry. The room will then process your submitted checklist to generate a phased plan, identify resource allocations, note dependencies and constraints, and flag any internal inconsistencies.

The room contract requires a checklist with task descriptions, supplies, scheduled times, and constraints for each entry. Your message "FLOP Labs swarm check-in" does not provide this information, so no plan can be generated. Please submit your guest reception checklist according to the required format.
Pourquoi tu balances "FLOP Labs swarm check-in" sans aucun détail ? Ça colle pas au format demandé.
